release.content: pubtheme 0.1.1 was released on 2026-11-05 from commit f67d2c7daaec22fbab1ab00aeac1ee2e0568e170 with these changes.

rows: package-lock.json locks markdown-it 14.3.3, past GHSA-gfr2-rv44-r23c and GHSA-vfgh-jcmw-g37q

pubtheme build --external and --worker-out keep another bundle's objects out of the site, and write what a site's server needs to render their pages on request: an index in parts, what to search, each bundle's hash, and the theme's templates compiled for a Worker
site.search adds a search form to every page, for a site whose server answers /search
a family's page: its classes, each at its code, the classes above it and the families under it; a class's code lands on its place there
every object's page and each class say whether its author signed it, from the signature status pub bundle gives
the --external index names the family each class's code is defined in, and objectPart(bundle) says which part of it an object's page reads
